article.title: Herd immunity update
article.excerpt: A herd immunity data point: Borough Park in NYC has one of the highest antibody rates seen in the developed world: 43.9%, based on a huge testing program covering almost 1/3 of local pop. This week positivity rates of Covid-19 tests coming back hit 17%. Here is the Mike Bird tweet , via a retweet from Alex T., and here is the WSJ article .
